question_cn: 西班牙开局中黑方有潜在的d5突破，但需要多步准备（Na5、c5、Nc6等）才能发动。为什么「准备充分再行动」优于立刻尝试突破？
question_en: In the Ruy Lopez, why might Black prepare the ...d5 break with moves such as ...Na5, ...c5, and ...Nc6 instead of playing it immediately?

options.text_cn: 多步准备只是在浪费时间，突破应该越早越好
options.text_en: Preparation wastes time; a pawn break should always be played as early as possible.

options.text_cn: 过早突破时子力配合不足，白方可以从容应对；充分准备后突破时多个子力同时发力，对方难以防守
options.text_en: An early break may lack piece support, while a prepared break can bring several pieces into action at once and be harder to meet.

options.text_cn: 准备只是为了防守，不是为了进攻
options.text_en: Preparation is only defensive, not part of an attack.

options.text_cn: 突破前必须等待对方主动行动，不应自己推进
options.text_en: You must wait for the opponent to act before making a pawn break.

explanation_cn: 「准备充分再行动」的战略价值：突破的威力取决于有多少子力能立刻参与配合。西班牙d5突破前：Na5将Bb3逼走（或兑换）、c5增加d5格的控制、Nc6重新配置——每一步都在为d5铺路。当d5终于走出时，己方Nd7/Re8/Bb7等子力全部就位，突破产生最大冲击。过早突破则孤掌难鸣，白方可以轻松化解。好的战略计划像多米诺骨牌，每步棋推动下一步，时机到来时一击即发。
explanation_en: A pawn break is strongest when several pieces can support it immediately. Moves such as ...Na5, ...c5, and ...Nc6 can prepare ...d5 by displacing a bishop, controlling key squares, and repositioning pieces. Once the supporting pieces are ready, the break has greater impact. Played too early, it may be easy to meet; a good plan lets each move prepare the next.
